scenario: `scope logical ambient` per LSCP.6.4 (overlay) — `schema Foo scope logical ambient:` declares an ambient-overlay schema on a logical base; this compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Config scope logical ambient:
    entity_id: String key
    threshold: Float mutable

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable

rule r:
    Config c
    Sensor s where s.val > c.threshold
->
    log info "above threshold"
